$description: Batatabit design tokens (W3C DTCG). Primitives hold raw values; semantic tokens alias primitives and say when to use them. Components consume semantic tokens. scripts/build-tokens.mjs turns this file into src/styles/tokens.css.

orange.$description: Brand orange scale: 500 is the solid brand colour, 100 the soft tint, 600 a darker orange for UI boundaries (3:1 on light surfaces).

blue.$description: Brand blue scale: 500 is the solid brand colour, 100 the soft tint.

neutral.$description: Warm neutral scale: 900 darkest (text on light, dark surfaces), 800 raised dark surface and soft-chip text, 600 muted text on light, 500 muted text on dark, 50 page background, 0 white.

green.$description: Success green: 500 is the base, 600 meets 3:1 on white for icons.

red.$description: Danger red used for the price-decrease icon.

primary.$description: Brand orange for solid fills and non-text accents: footer background, solid badge background, accent bars, icons. Never for text (2.17:1 on off-white). Text placed on it uses color.on-primary.

primary-soft.$description: Tint of brand orange for soft backgrounds (chips, pills) and for the lead text on the hero gradient, the one documented contrast exception (3.03:1 at worst; see gradient.hero). Text on a primary-soft background uses color.text-on-soft.

secondary.$description: Brand blue for solid fills and non-text accents: secondary badge background, accent bars. Never for text (2.83:1 on off-white). Text placed on it uses color.on-secondary.

secondary-soft.$description: Tint of brand blue for soft backgrounds (chips, pills). Text on it uses color.text-on-soft.

surface-dark.$description: Darkest surface: background of dark sections and the dark end of gradient.hero. Text on it uses color.text-on-dark, or color.text-muted-on-dark for secondary text.

surface-dark-raised.$description: Surface one step above color.surface-dark, for cards on a dark section (feature cards). Not a page background.

surface-page.$description: Page background of the main content area. For button fills use color.surface-button; for cards and cells use color.surface-card.

surface-button.$description: Fill of every button, light and outline. Label and icon colour on it: color.on-button.

surface-card.$description: Pure white fill of cards and table cells that sit on color.surface-page: plan cards, data cells.

text-strong.$description: Primary text on light surfaces: headings, prices, plan titles, table titles and values. 15.69:1 on off-white, 16.62:1 on white. Use color.text-muted for secondary text.

text-muted.$description: Secondary text on light surfaces: lead paragraphs, table labels, small notes. 4.82:1 on off-white, 5.10:1 on white. Use color.text-strong for anything that must stand out.

text-muted-on-dark.$description: Secondary text on dark surfaces: section leads, card body text. 4.85:1 on surface-dark-raised, 5.34:1 on surface-dark. Use color.text-on-dark for headings.

text-on-dark.$description: Primary text on dark surfaces and on the hero gradient: headings, card titles. On orange or blue fills use color.on-primary or color.on-secondary instead.

text-on-soft.$description: Text drawn over color.primary-soft or color.secondary-soft chips. 12.83:1 on primary-soft, 13.58:1 on secondary-soft.

on-primary.$description: Text and icons placed on color.primary fills: solid orange badge, footer links. 7.23:1.

on-secondary.$description: Text and icons placed on color.secondary fills: solid blue badge. 5.55:1.

on-button.$description: Label and icon colour on color.surface-button. 15.69:1.

border-accent.$description: Outline colour of outline buttons. 3.22:1 on off-white, 3.41:1 on white. Use color.primary for fills, not for borders.

trend-up.$description: Colour of the price-increase icon. 3.23:1 on white. Always give the icon a text alternative; never rely on colour alone.

trend-down.$description: Colour of the price-decrease icon. 3.66:1 on white. Always give the icon a text alternative; never rely on colour alone.

size.$description: Font sizes in rem on the 62.5% root (1rem = 10px). The key is the pixel size.

line-height.$description: Line heights in rem on the 62.5% root. The key is the pixel size.

letter-spacing.$description: Letter spacing: tight is -2%, used by data text.

body.$description: Font for headings and running text, including table titles; the default for all UI text. Data, numbers and small labels use font.data.

data.$description: Font for data, numbers and small labels: table cells, prices, notes, chips and badges. Headings and running text use font.body.

card.$description: Corner radius of large cards and table grids: plan cards, currency tables. 8px.

card-compact.$description: Corner radius of small cards on dark sections: feature cards. 4px.

chip.$description: Corner radius of chips, pills and badges. 8px.

space.$description: Spacing scale on a 4px grid. The key is the pixel size.

divider.$description: Width of the line between data-table cells: 1px.

sombra-blanco.$description: Warm-tinted elevation shadow: 0 4 8, rgba(89,73,30,0.16). Referenced by shadow.on-light.

sombra-negro.$description: Neutral elevation shadow: 0 4 8, rgba(0,0,0,0.16). Referenced by shadow.on-dark.

on-light.$description: Elevation shadow for elements on light surfaces: buttons, plan cards. Warm-tinted.

on-dark.$description: Elevation shadow for elements on dark surfaces: feature cards. Neutral black.

hero.$description: Hero background only: dark at the top-right to orange at the bottom-left. The hero lead (color.primary-soft) on it measures 3.03:1 at worst, below WCAG AA; this is a deliberate brand decision. Place no other text on this gradient.

image-scrim.$description: Dark scrim over the top of a photo that carries white text (the 'Conócelo hoy.' heading): 55% surface-dark fading to transparent at 75% of the height. Keeps white text at 3:1 or better on the photo; add it to any photo section with text on top.

tablet.$description: Viewport width from which the tablet typography and layout apply: 768px. Custom properties cannot be used in media queries, so tokens.css and global.css repeat this value.

hero-min-height.$description: Minimum height of the hero: 334px on mobile, 480px from the tablet breakpoint.

hero-padding-top.$description: Space above the hero logo block: 48px on mobile, 64px from the tablet breakpoint. With layout.hero-logo-margin-top the logo sits 56px (mobile) and 104px (tablet) from the top of the hero.

hero-logo-margin-top.$description: Space between the top padding of the hero and the logo: 8px on mobile, 40px from the tablet breakpoint.

title-measure.$description: Maximum width of a section title block (heading and lead): the full width on mobile, 466px from the tablet breakpoint.

content-max-width.$description: Maximum width of multi-column content blocks: currency tables and feature cards.

heading-lg.$description: Headings (h1, h2). 24/26 bold below 768px, 40/42 bold from 768px; the base variables switch automatically.

mobile.$description: Heading size below 768px. Use through the base tokens, not directly.

tablet.$description: Heading size from 768px up. Applied automatically; do not reference directly.

lead.$description: Lead paragraph under a heading and the footer links. 14/18 medium below 768px, 20/24 medium from 768px; the base variables switch automatically.

mobile.$description: Lead size below 768px. Use through the base tokens, not directly.

tablet.$description: Lead size from 768px up. Applied automatically; do not reference directly.

body-sm.$description: Small running text inside cards and lists: card body, plan title. 14/18 medium at every width.

button.$description: Label of every button and link-button. Bold 14/18.

title-md.$description: Title above a data table. DM Sans bold 18/23.

title-sm.$description: Title of a feature card. Bold 18/18; single-line titles only.

data-label.$description: First-column text in data tables: currency or exchange name. Inter medium 16/19, -2% tracking.

data-value.$description: Value column in data tables. Inter regular 16/19, -2% tracking, same size as text.data-label.

caption.$description: Small supporting text: chips and pills. Inter regular 12/15.

note.$description: Small note under a price and the currency symbol. Inter medium 12/15.

badge.$description: Label of solid badges and the bold word inside a chip. Inter bold 12/15.

price.$description: Large price figure on a plan card. Inter bold 52/53.
